thread:
maya: Pushed libpq CVE patch to staging (build 2026.03.20-patch1). Need quick sync on post-patch validation and canary cadence. Proposal: smoke tests + perf regression checks, canary 10% -> 50% -> 100% with monitoring windows.

liam: Ack. Paste the exact smoke checks and I'll wire alerts.

maya: Smoke checklist: 1) health/readiness: `curl -f https://staging-api.redwood.ai/health || exit 1` 2) auth flow: create token + single-shot `/v1/generate` 3) DB connectivity: `SELECT 1` against primary read pool 4) audit logging: perform an RBAC change and confirm entry in audit stream 5) KV cache sanity: check qcache hit ratio.

akash: For perf: run a short ramped load to catch p95 spikes. Example command: ```k6 run --vus 50 --duration 5m k6_generate.js``` Target `/v1/generate` with realistic prompt sizes. Watch p50/p95/p99 and qcache hit ratio.

sofia: I'll add dashboards and alerts. Suggested alerts: - error rate (5xx) > 0.5% for 5m - sustained p95 latency increase > 20% vs baseline for 10m - KV cache hit ratio drop > 10% - audit-log sink lag > 60s.

liam: Canary tagging: ensure canary traffic has `deployment.canary=true` label and compare cohort metrics to `deployment.canary=false`. That gives per-cohort SLO checks.

maya: Proposed rollout: 10% for 30m, if green -> 50% for 1h, then 100% for 2h. Rollback triggers: 5xx > threshold, sustained p95 regress > 20% vs baseline, or audit-log sink lag > 120s.

sec-bot: Automated note: CVE-2026-0421 (libpq) patch applied to staging by maya. Build: 2026.03.20-patch1. Next step: execute post-patch validation checklist.

akash: Quick KMS note: verify the patched client works with rotated envelope keys. Steps: 1) run `pg_isready` 2) open a DB session using rotated KMS envelope key 3) run the SELECT. If KMS returns 403 or decryption fails, abort canary.

sofia: Dashboards updated: created `canary_overview`, `canary_errors`, `canary_latency`, `audit_log_lag`. I added Grafana panels for cohort comparison and qcache hit ratio.

liam: Alerts created and routed to #oncall and paged on infra-p1 if thresholds tripped. Also created a temporary alert to detect any RBAC audit failures.

sre-bot: Canary started: cohort=10%, window=30m, tag=deployment.canary=true. Monitoring hooks: error_rate, p95_latency, qcache_hit, audit_lag.

maya: Running smoke checks now. health ok, auth flow ok, DB SELECT ok. Doing RBAC audit test next.

liam: Received test alerts feed. No anomalies so far.

sofia: Initial k6 run (10% traffic mixed) shows p95 +8% vs baseline, p99 unchanged, qcache hit steady. No alert.

akash: KMS rotated-key connect successful, plaintext access ok. Verified sample transaction and commit.

sre-bot: Canary update: 10% window passed, no rollback triggers. Advancing to 50% for 1h.

maya: Advancing to 50% now. Tagging release and noting rollback window.

sofia: After 35m at 50%: slight p95 bump ~10% (within threshold), error rate unchanged, audit-log lag ~20s. Looks stable.

liam: Confirmed audit stream contains RBAC test entries for user `maya-test` and action `grant-role`. Timestamps match.

maya: OK to promote to 100% and monitor for 2h. If anything odd, we'll rollback and run deeper perf CI. :thumbsup:

sre-bot: Promoting to 100% now. Monitoring for 2h.

sofia: I'll keep dashboards pinned and push a quick postdeploy note in #eng-status at +30m and +2h.

liam: Oncall standing by. If we see p95 > 20% or error rate spike we'll do rollback.

sec-bot: Reminder: create a vuln triage entry linking this patch to CVE-2026-0421 and update risk rating after production validation.

maya: Will open the triage ticket and attach smoke logs + k6 artifacts. Thanks everyone for quick sync.

sre-bot: Canary finished 2h. Final summary: error rate = 0.12%, p95 = +6% vs baseline, qcache hit ratio steady, audit-log lag median 18s. No rollback needed. Closing thread.
